arr_services.path_mapping_hint_prefix: Only needed when legendarr and this server run in separate containers with different mounts — e.g. the server reports
arr_services.path_mapping_hint_suffix: but legendarr sees the same files under
subtitle_acquisition.providers_hint: Enable the subtitle providers you want legendarr to use, and configure credentials where a provider needs them. Searching and downloading subtitles from these providers isn't built yet — this only registers which ones are available and confirms they're reachable.
subtitle_acquisition.no_credentials_hint: {label} doesn't need any credentials — "Test connection" only checks the site is reachable once search/download is built.
subtitle_acquisition.animetosho_api_key_: Optional — Anime Tosho search still works without it, matching episodes by their release filename instead of an exact id. This is an AniDB HTTP API client name, not a password for animetosho.org itself — register one for free on anidb.net and paste it here to resolve the exact episode instead of guessing from the filename.
subtitle_acquisition.legendas_net_email_: This is the email address for your legendas.net account login — not your site display username.
subtitle_acquisition.include_ai_translat: Include subtitles generated by opensubtitles.com's AI translation service in search results
subtitle_acquisition.include_machine_tra: Include subtitles machine translated by users in search results
subtitle_acquisition.description.opensub: The largest general subtitle database, covering most movies and TV shows in dozens of languages.
subtitle_acquisition.description.addic7e: Community-driven site focused on TV shows, usually first to have subtitles for new episodes.
subtitle_acquisition.description.yify_su: Subtitles matched specifically to YIFY/YTS movie releases.
subtitle_acquisition.description.subdl: General-purpose subtitle search covering movies and TV shows.
subtitle_acquisition.description.tvsubti: Subtitle archive dedicated to TV shows.
subtitle_acquisition.description.legenda: Brazilian Portuguese subtitle community for movies and TV shows.
subtitle_acquisition.description.napipro: Polish subtitle database, matched by file hash rather than title.
subtitle_acquisition.description.subsour: General-purpose subtitle search for movies and TV shows.
subtitle_acquisition.description.animeto: Anime release tracker with subtitle downloads, matched by filename or an AniDB id.
subtitle_acquisition.description.supersu: Hungarian subtitle database for movies and TV shows.
subtitle_acquisition.description.animeka: Turkish subtitle community focused on anime.
subtitle_acquisition.description.greeksu: Greek subtitle database for movies and TV shows.
subtitle_acquisition.description.betaser: French TV show tracking site with a subtitle search API.
subtitle_translation.providers_hint: Enable the translation engines you want legendarr to use, and configure credentials where an engine needs them. Translation jobs try the default provider first, falling back through every other enabled, credentialed engine in order if it fails. `echo` (returns the source text unchanged) is always available too, for development.
subtitle_translation.no_credentials_hint: {label} doesn't need any credentials — "Test connection" only checks the engine is reachable.
subtitle_translation.model_hint: Leave Endpoint and Model blank to use OpenAI's API with gpt-4o-mini — set them to point at a self-hosted or third-party OpenAI-compatible endpoint instead.
subtitle_translation.prompt_template_pla: Leave blank to use the default prompt
subtitle_translation.prompt_template_hin: Uses {source}, {target}, and {count} as placeholders. Write a literal curly brace twice in a row so it isn't read as one.
subtitle_proxies.hint: Register a proxy (e.g. FlareSolverr) subtitle providers can be pointed at from their own edit page to get past a CAPTCHA or Cloudflare wall.
media_metadata.hint: Enable the metadata sources legendarr should use to fetch info about new series and movies, and set the API key each one needs. Runs automatically the next time a library sync finds a brand-new series or movie.
media_metadata.add_api_key_to_enable: Add an API key to enable
media_servers.hint: Enable the media servers legendarr should notify after a subtitle is written, and set the address and token each one needs. Runs automatically after an acquisition or translation writes a subtitle, refreshing just that item where the server supports it.
media_servers.add_address_token_to_enabl: Add an address and token to enable
media_servers.keep_current_token_placeho: Leave blank to keep the current token
history.subtitle: Translation and acquisition attempts, most recent first.
history.empty: No translation or acquisition activity yet — history will appear here once a subtitle is translated or acquired.
statistics.subtitle: Translation and acquisition activity, over time.
settings.auth.regenerate_confirm: Regenerate the API key? Anything using the old one will stop working.
settings.auth.api_key_hint: Used by scripts/tools for non-interactive access to the API.
settings.auth.hint: When enabled, every page requires logging in and the backend API requires either that login's session or the API key below — leave it off on a trusted network.
settings.auth.api_key_empty: Generated automatically the first time login is enabled and saved.
settings.tasks.hint: Changes apply to the running scheduler immediately — no restart needed. Saving restarts each task's interval countdown.
settings.tasks.sync_hint: Pulls the movie and series lists from every enabled Radarr/Sonarr connection.
settings.tasks.scan_hint: Walks every synced item's local folder to locate the video files on disk. Imports also trigger an immediate per-item scan via webhook or history poll — the webhook cascades all the way through subtitle discovery, acquisition, and translation.
settings.tasks.history_poll_hint: Asks each connection's history for recent imports and rescans just those items — catches new files quickly when the Arr webhook isn't configured.
